verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents several APIs (Harvest-style candidate API, Job Board API, Assessment Partner API, Candidate Ingestion, webhooks), so the axis applies. None of the evidence mentions API versioning, version identifiers, or a deprecation or sunset policy. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, which also leaves versioning unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
